LOOK: Photos show a quarry site that has been operating for about a decade in the Sierra Madre mountain range, Barangay San Isidro, Angono, Rizal on Tuesday, August 5.

The local government of Angono, together with its residents, continues to oppose quarrying activities in the area, citing environmental degradation that contributes to severe flooding in Rizal province and nearby cities during the typhoon season.

Officials and residents alike argue that the environmental and health impacts of quarrying far outweigh its economic benefits, warning that the continued destruction of the mountains poses long-term risks to both nature and public safety. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
